title: Purging Changed Nothing for This Model
subtitle: Out of sample Sharpe with a 20 day label horizon, purge and 10 row embargo against neither
caption: The differences are in the third decimal and change sign between the two split kinds. ICs move by less than 0.002. A 7 coefficient ridge on tens of thousands of pooled rows cannot memorize the 21 rows at each boundary whose labels overlap the test block.
source: the project's experiment runs, walk-forward and k-fold at a 20 day horizon, with and without purging
